newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indocement awaits Indofood rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Indocement awaits Indofood rights issue.

text.p: Indonesia's cement giant PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa said on Tuesday it planned to use proceeds from the sale of its Bogasari Flour Mill to subscribe to an expected rights issue by its subsidiary PT Indofood Sukses Makmur.

"Indocement is now ready with the cash to pay for it (the subscription). We don't need to look for other funds to finance it. We've funds from the proceeds from the Bogasari sale to finance the purchase," Subrata told Reuters.
Indocement sold its Bogasari Flour Mill for 1.86 trillion rupiah to Indofood last June.
Subrata said Indocement would subscribe to Indofood's expected rights issue in line with its stakeholding in Indofood.
Subrata said Indocement had a stake of around 52 percent in Indonesia's largest noodle maker Indofood.
Both Indocement and Indofood are members of the country's largest conglomerate the Salim Group and are among the largest capitalised firms on the Jakarta stock exchange.
Subrata declined to give details of the expected rights issue, but said Indofood was expected to make the issue between late March and April this year.
He said Indofood was expected to use the proceeds of the rights issue to finance its proposed acquisition of its subsidiaries.

Indofood said last November it expected to release details of a plan to acquire majority shareholding in its principal distributor PT Indomarco and several edible oils and fats firms belonging to the Salim Group in late January this year.
Subrata said the rights issue proposal was now in its final stage of valuation before being submitted into the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) expected in the second week of February.
